quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on the physical toll of an elite NBA career
quotes.excerpt: Anthony Edwards is unfortunate, but the amount of explosion that he plays basketball with at his age.
quotes.quote: Anthony Edwards is unfortunate, but the amount of explosion that he plays basketball with at his age. Think about how many Western Conference Finals he's been to, the Olympics, doing all this stuff, it's a lot for his body too. Kawhi Leonard, I mean, the sky is blue. We know he's going to be hurt every year. The Anthony Edwards thing, when you come back and you're doing these dunks on your Achilles, stuff is happening to your body. The recovery, I don't mind. Jaren Jackson, Paolo is usually hurt every single year. They're just injury prone players. Like, he tore an oblique or he hurt an oblique and Jaren Jackson Jr. has been hurt for Memphis for a long time.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins reflects on Ernie Johnson's legendary work ethic
quotes.excerpt: The focus that he had on it, I was like, it was like a wake-up moment.
quotes.quote: I go to Atlanta and I'm going on KG Certified, which was in the same studio during the same time. I see everybody, I dab up Charles, I dab up Shaq, and I go to Ernie. He's at a desk and he has these papers scattered out everywhere. He stands up, he's like, hey, Perk, what's going on? I'm like, what's going on? How you doing, man? I'm ready to have a conversation, but I could tell he's like, he sits right back down and he's like writing this stuff down, no help, no laptop. It's like writing it down, getting ready for his show. And the focus that he had on it, I was like, it was like a wake-up moment like, this is some serious shit. This ain't just going on TV and just going talking out your ass or coming up with something. You take a different level of respect and that stood out to me, how locked in it was. It wasn't fucking off, he was literally like facing a wall in the corner with no laptop and I was just like, the fuck. And this is like greatness.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Breen's genuine excitement receiving a toss from Ernie Johnson
quotes.excerpt: to see a 65-year-old who is Mike Breen and he's like a kid that he gets a toss
quotes.quote: So, Mike Breen, one of the goats in television history, not just sports. We got our first bang last night of the season. The first time Ernie tossed to Mike because they'd never worked together ever. The producers were in our ear and Mike was like, that's so cool. To see a 65-year-old who is Mike Breen and he's like a kid that he gets a toss from Ernie for the first time ever. I happen to be right next to Mike. So to see his reaction, he was like, that's so cool that Ernie's tossing to me. He was excited.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Breen's preparation and respect for Ernie Johnson's retirement announcement
quotes.excerpt: Mike Breen is saying, we have to address this. So, we do this and we're like, 100%
quotes.quote: We walk into the green room, Katie George and I, and Mike's already there. This man has seven pages of notes on every player because he does stories on every player. He is the ultimate. He goes, hey guys, I'm thinking about changing the open today. Ernie just announced he's retiring and I think it's only right that we all kind of say something. If you guys have something to say, what do you guys think? But we have to address it. So Mike Breen is saying, we have to address this. So, we do this and we're like, 100%.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Honoring Ernie Johnson's retirement on the broadcast
quotes.excerpt: that's the ultimate respect that you can have is that your peers are saying, we're going to celebrate him
quotes.quote: We watch Ernie do his conversation. We watch Charles Barkley in tears and the emotion and it's crazy because we are the next up. It was just so cool that Mike wanted to give him that moment. That's the ultimate respect that you can have is that your peers are saying, we're going to celebrate him. I said to Mike, thank you, that was such a good idea that he just had a feel for the moment that this game is important, but let's address the news.
